capabilities: Export the current note to .docx from the command palette, ribbon or right-click menu
Convert Markdown elements to Word styles (headings, lists, tables, callouts, footnotes, code blocks)
Embed vault images with preserved widths and render wikilinks as display text
Compile a folder into one .docx with chapter headings, cover page and table of contents (Pro)
Apply a user's own Word template file for fonts, colors and spacing (Pro)
extras: Freemium: free exports always work offline; Pro costs 19 USD one-time and the license check contacts api.gumroad.com only on activation. Known limits include one-line footnote definitions, note embeds and SVG/WebP shown as labels, and LibreOffice needing a manual field update for TOC page numbers.
intentEvidence: No Pandoc or other software to install.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn notes into .docx files that use Word's own heading, footnote and template styles without installing external software.

relations.evidence: No Pandoc or other software to install.

requires.name: Gumroad license key for Pro features (own Word template, page numbers, folder compilation, cover page, table of contents)

summary: Exports Obsidian notes to Word (.docx) files with real Word styles, on desktop and mobile, without Pandoc.
